title: DSCD: Large Language Model Detoxification with Self-Constrained Decoding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to adversarial jailbreak prompts using safety classifiers (RoBERTa and GPT-4o) to calculate Defense Success Rate (DS) and Harmful Scores on datasets such as SafeEdit, HarmfulQA, DangerousQA, and Advbench.
